create_task_world: create a DialogPartnerWorld or MultiWorld from opt and user agents using create_task_world
create_task: create a world with task agents and optional batching using create_task with opt and user agents
run_dialog_partner_world: run a two-agent turn-based dialog loop using DialogPartnerWorld parley method
run_multiworld: run multiple worlds in round-robin fashion using MultiWorld with multitask weights
run_batch_world: run minibatch training over multiple world copies using BatchWorld with batchsize option
